title: Assign Blame with Backpropagation
core_invariant: Backpropagation is structured credit assignment on a named forward graph: local derivatives composed in reverse, with branches accumulating by sum. Analytic / backprop gradients must agree with central finite differences within declared tolerance on smooth parameters. Predict gradient signs before deriving them. One declared update only; no framework autograd and no training loop. Generic WP-137 metric, table, and trace blocks carry the evidence; there is no custom frontend.

stages.title: Restate the one-parameter gradient invariant and named graph
stages.instructions: Restate the M19 one-parameter gradient invariant and draw the M23 forward pass as a named computation graph: x → hidden_preactivation → hidden_activation → logits → probabilities → softmax-NLL loss. Teaching controls: ReLU at zero uses derivative 0.0, targets [0, 0], mean reduction, central finite difference, epsilon 1e-5, atol 1e-6, rtol 1e-5, update θ ← θ − η g. Identify gate evidence: a WP-137 metric of selected gradients, a table of epsilon-sweep vs analytic, and a trace of reverse accumulation. Do not open torch.autograd or a training loop.

stages.title: Predict signs, backpropagate, and check finite differences
stages.instructions: Complete the experiment cycle on the teaching graph. (1) PREDICT selected gradient signs by perturbing a parameter up and down before deriving them, and predict whether a value feeding two downstream paths receives one contribution or the sum. (2) COMMIT the prediction. (3) EXECUTE / RUN scalar-chain reverse mode, branch accumulation, a tiny dense-layer/activation backward pass, and a central finite-difference sweep; emit WP-137 blocks: a metric of analytic vs backprop vs finite-difference gradients, a table of epsilon vs error, and a trace of reverse topological order. (4) OBSERVE. (5) SUBMIT an explanation of any delta. Apply one small learning-rate update and verify local loss movement without claiming global convergence. ReLU at zero remains 0.0. No autograd.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Prediction is sealed before execute; manual and programmatic gradients agree within tolerance on smooth parameters; one declared update only.

stages.title: Read stored values, local rules, and reverse order
stages.instructions: Read the reverse-mode implementation. Identify stored forward values, local derivative rules, reverse topological order, gradient accumulation, and gradient-reset semantics. Submit an annotated system-flow artifact.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: The trace names stored values, local rules, reverse order, accumulation, and reset without opening a framework autograd engine.

stages.title: Diagnose an omitted branch or wrong ReLU derivative
stages.instructions: Inject one named local-rule defect: omit one branch contribution into a shared node, or treat relu' as identity including on non-positive pre-activations. Predict whether a dead ReLU unit should pass an upstream gradient. The defect can still emit finite gradient-looking numbers. Isolate the first finite-difference mismatch on the true loss. Repair only the named local rule. Emit a WP-137 table of first-mismatch parameter and a trace of the missing contribution.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Names the omitted-branch or wrong-ReLU defect, shows the first finite-difference mismatch, and restores only that local rule.

stages.title: Fresh gradient trace without assistance
stages.instructions: From a blank page, backpropagate a fresh scalar chain and a tiny dense layer, check selected gradients with central finite differences, and apply one declared update. Tutor surfaces stay locked. Emit a WP-137 metric of independent gradient agreement. Do not open autograd or a training loop.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Independent no-AI reverse mode agrees with finite differences on the fresh case; claims cite named gradients.

stages.title: Author a V05 gradient-verification policy ADR
stages.instructions: Record parameters and cases checked, tolerance and epsilon, when checks run, blocking failures, owner, status, and date. Formal engineering review is required for this mission. Future-mission autograd and training loops stay closed.

stages.title: Evaluate backpropagation evidence
stages.instructions: Evaluate submitted orientation, reverse-mode experiment, controlled-failure diagnosis, and unassisted transfer against the gate contract. Issue PASSED or a targeted repair plan. Do not award completion from 'backprop is working.'
